patch_description:
Replace the current ansatz block with the seed motif-inspired block that previously gave stronger performance. The new block:

- Restores symmetry-grouped RY rotations (corners/edges/center) for effective local encoding.
- Uses shared CRZ couplings around the ring and a distinct center coupling to distribute entanglement consistently.
- Explicitly aligns ZZZ three-qubit rotations with the eight winning lines, split into rows/cols/diagonals so the circuit can learn line-specific correlations (motif discovery).
- Adds CCRZ interactions grouped into center/diagonal symmetry classes to capture higher-order correlations.
- Uses compact final rotations combining RZ and RX per symmetry zone (corners/edges/center) to increase local expressivity while keeping parameter sharing for efficiency.

This increases N_PARAMS_per_block slightly (to the proven seed design) and reintroduces the motif-aligned triple interactions that improved validation/test accuracy in prior runs. The structure balances expressive three-qubit motifs with parameter efficiency via symmetry sharing.
